_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Mixed factors and coil base-rate favor holding the current Disbelief rung until a clear breaker appears in momentum or vol.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicitly HOLD/Disbelief; narrative is descriptive/neutral and does not push a directional phase shift
next_move.confirmed_if: vix stays elevated and gold_strength keeps rising while btc_momentum_30d and funding remain soft
next_move.invalidated_if: btc_momentum_30d turns sharply higher and funding flips sustainably positive with VIX compressing
